evidence: tenant-access-policy-effective-p0 maps asesores to Equipo and denies full team directory to Operativo.
store-firestore-product-readonly-p0 returns full documents for allowed collections, so widening asesores read access would violate least privilege.
core/ciclo.js assignableAdvisors() currently reads store.all('asesores'), therefore Carlos/Operativo receives an empty roster upstream.
assignableAdvisors.remedy: Add a server-owned minimal assignable-advisor projection and client facade. Keep full Equipo restricted. Project only canonical id, display name, active/assignable state, Asesor-role eligibility and compatible countries; dedupe canonically and react to country.

evidence: core/ciclo.js nuevoNegocio() uses free-text inputs/defaults for Canal, Producto and Ramo.
core/config.js Orbit.cat persists only to localStorage.
functions/tenant-domain-config.js has durable tenant configuration but does not yet expose a catalogs domain.
Configuracion lacks complete durable tenant catalog administration.
tenantCatalogs.remedy: Extend the existing tenant-domain config owner with a catalogs domain; hydrate Orbit.cat from server-owned tenant config; expose Configuracion administration; make new/edit flows consume the same authority without hardcoded business truth.

rootCauses: calidad.js uses synchronous store.update followed by immediate local readback instead of awaited updateDurable/server commit.
Orbit.GEO is an explicitly reduced embedded subset rather than a complete governed GT/CO locality catalog.
Quality UI conflates current country value with linked provenance evidence.
No-contact rows render a disabled Sin canal button.
clientQuality.remedy: Await durable server write/readback before rerender/audit; separate current country from provenance; use a complete governed GT/CO geography dataset shared by Calidad and Cliente360; make contact completion actionable.

financialQuality.remedy: Expose contractual source, active schedule/receipt lineage, exact normalized delta, tolerance and safe drill-down/actions; never rewrite premium or receipts by inference; normalize negative zero and precision-only deltas.

renewals.adjudication: Existing fail-closed YES/NO/UNKNOWN semantics are correct and must be preserved. The remaining blocker is source-backed/human-auditable completion, not permission to infer.
renewals.remedy: Add an auditable validation surface for UNKNOWN renewability and missing financial fields. No operational row is changed by this source-fix commit; later human/source confirmation remains explicit and server-owned.

insurerSources.remedy: Create one canonical source-registry projection that labels Library reference, Drive file or both; expand document taxonomy and normalized metadata; keep all downstream tariff/calc enablement fail-closed and preserve gravicentra-quote-authority-v1.

emailTraceability.adjudication: Existing B4-002 outbox/retry source remediation does not prove mailbox delivery. These findings remain open until provider acceptance/delivery or bounce/failure evidence is obtained; they are not silently closed by R16.
